name: sentimental-piano-room-with-the-light-going
brief: A late-evening room with the light going. One person stops working and does not start again. The cup goes cold, the chair stays where it was, the room keeps the shape of the day. No words: a felt piano holds one four-note motif while the window light moves across the floor, reaches the wall, and leaves.

_engine_defects.what: The planner queue could not express an instrumental track
_engine_defects.was: brief schema {name, genre, brief, lyricsMode?, language?, title?, duration?} had no instrumental field; planner.py --lyrics-mode accepted only draft|ai; a draft was refused by acestep_plan.py (exit 1, the 'refused' markers).
_engine_defects.now: lyricsMode: instrumental (or instrumental: true) is first-class; planner.py refuses it on a vocal genre, so it cannot strip a choir genre's defining element. The live ConfigMap entry for this track uses it and rendered.
